Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-106.json runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli start --case ../data/cases/dev/case-106.json --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1 --slot 0 --why "Slot 0 at t=31.154 separates the leading pairs 0-1 0-4 1-2 1-3 1-4 2-4 3-4 all at 4 sigma, the best multi-pair discriminator available"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1 --slot 4 --why "Slot 4 at t=36.283 is the top discriminator for all three live pairs 0-2 0-3 2-3 simultaneously at 4 sigma"
cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli diagnostics --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1

cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1 --slot 7 --why "Confirmation observation at t=42.112 for the leading pairs 0-2 and 0-3 since candidate 0 crossed theta after only two observations"

content.text: Support confirms candidate 0 at 1.0, well above theta. Finalizing.

input.command: cd D:/Apps/micro1-frontier-hackathon/runtime && python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v1-case-106-r1 --why "Candidate 0 period 12.3205d reached support 0.999 after two observations and held at 1.0 after a confirmation observation, clearing theta with the remaining candidates driven to zero"
